title: We built a multiplayer game where Claude can change the rules while you play
author: Confident-Honeydew66
selftext:
Over the past few weeks, me and one other dev have been working on, a free multiplayer sandbox that runs in the browser, kind of like Garry's Mod. You and your friends join a shared world, and anyone can type a request like "make gravity flip every 10 seconds." Claude writes that into the game live, so everyone in the lobby sees the change right away.

Claude helped design the scripting API and the system prompt. Most of the work was iterating on those until Claude's changes stopped breaking the game every other prompt.

The clip is my friends and me completely breaking it. I hope you all enjoy because we had so much fun making this lmao
